# ductus

> Gauge which parts of a text read as machine-written, and why, with the evidence anchored to exact characters


## Pages in this subsection

- [ductus](ductus.html.md): ductus – gauge which parts of a text read as machine-written, and why.
- [ductus.base](ductus.base.html.md): The data model: where a finding lives, what it claims, and how much it weighs.
- [ductus.core](ductus.core.html.md): The core: stream segments, or take the whole report. Everything else is a surface.
- [ductus.curvature](ductus.curvature.html.md): Model-based detectors – the &#96;&#91;local&#93;&#96; extra. Two more functions of the same shape.
- [ductus.data](ductus.data.html.md): Page content
- [ductus.detect](ductus.detect.html.md): The detectors – the &#96;detectors=&#96; seam. Each one turns a span into evidence.
- [ductus.http](ductus.http.html.md): The HTTP surface: the same verbs the CLI dispatches, served over HTTP.
- [ductus.mcp](ductus.mcp.html.md): The MCP surface: the same verbs the CLI dispatches, emitted as MCP tools.
- [ductus.render](ductus.render.html.md): Turning a report into something a person reads: JSON, Markdown, or HTML.
- [ductus.score](ductus.score.html.md): Turning evidence into a lean – the &#96;aggregate=&#96; seam.
- [ductus.segment](ductus.segment.html.md): Cutting a text into the units that get scored – the &#96;segmenter=&#96; seam.
- [ductus.tells](ductus.tells.html.md): The tells catalogue: named regular-expression patterns, tiered by confidence.
- [ductus.tools](ductus.tools.html.md): The verb SSOT: plain functions, JSON-ready in, JSON-ready out.
